mentions.name: Qt/QML flashcard app for reMarkable 2
mentions.description: A Qt + QML flashcard app that brings the Learnalist flashcard UX to the reMarkable 2 e-ink tablet. It is planned for release as a reference for others because the reMarkable ecosystem is currently too clunky to offer to non-technical users of the devices.
mentions.source_excerpt: I asked codex to use my mobile app and web page for the flashcard UX, and make me one using qt + qml so I could run it on the remarkable 2, super happy with the initial results. This will be released as a reference for others, as the eco-system is too clunky today to offer it the non-technical users of remarkable devices.
